title: Truth-Seeking Orb Barrage
body:
Syntax: perform truth-seeking orb barrage <target>

Description: Shape Truth-Seeking Orbs into a targeted barrage, dealing chakra damage with a chance to weaken the target. It does not instantly kill or permanently erase player equipment. Base damage: 1509-1789. 50% chance to inflict weakened. Unlocks at level 75 only for Ashura reincarnations of any combat class. Requires your Six Paths mode active. Train and use the technique to increase its mastery. Costs 90 Chakra and 10 Stamina; 18 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
